# Step - coin

`coin` · category: [Filters](../../traversal/step_reference.md#filters)

Keeps each traverser with the given probability (0.0 to 1.0); seed it with g.with("random.seed", n).

## Forms

```text
coin(arg1: f64)
coin(arg1: i64)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().coin(1.0).count().next()   // 6
```
